reason: I already book everything on the ticket apps I know, and they work fine for me. Escrow sounds good, but a new app launching in November isn't going to pull me away unless it has something I can't find anywhere else.
objection: If the host cancels, will I actually get my money back quickly, or will I be chasing a brand-new app and someone called TradeSafe for weeks? My usual platforms have already shown me they pay out.
would_change_my_mind: An event I actually want to go to that is only listed on TROVE, plus reviews from friends showing that refunds really came through.
